record.paper_title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities
record.original_question: Characterize exactly which three weakly decreasing real sequences a_1≥· · ·≥a_n, b_1≥· · ·≥b_n, and s_1≥· · ·≥s_n arise from Hermitian matrices A and B such that A has eigenvalues a_1,…,a_n, B has eigenvalues b_1,…,b_n, and the singular values of A+iB are s_1,…,s_n.

evidence.quote:
Problem 8 Determine the necessary and sufficient conditions on a1 ≥ · · · ≥
an, b1 ≥ · · · ≥ bn and s1 ≥ · · · ≥ sn for the existence of Hermitian matrices A
and B so that A has eigenvalues a1, . . . , an, B has eigenvalues b1, . . . , bn, and
A + iB has singular values s1, . . . , sn.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 1$ be an integer. For Hermitian $n \times n$ matrices $A$ and $B$, let $\lambda(A) = (a_1 \geq \cdots \geq a_n)$ and $\lambda(B) = (b_1 \geq \cdots \geq b_n)$ denote their (real) eigenvalues in weakly decreasing order, and let $\sigma(A+iB) = (s_1 \geq \cdots \geq s_n \geq 0)$ denote the singular values of the complex matrix $A + iB$ in weakly decreasing order.

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on three weakly decreasing real sequences
$$a_1 \geq a_2 \geq \cdots \geq a_n, \qquad b_1 \geq b_2 \geq \cdots \geq b_n, \qquad s_1 \geq s_2 \geq \cdots \geq s_n \geq 0,$$
in order that there exist Hermitian $n \times n$ matrices $A$ and $B$ for which $\lambda(A) = (a_1, \ldots, a_n)$, $\lambda(B) = (b_1, \ldots, b_n)$, and $\sigma(A+iB) = (s_1, \ldots, s_n)$.
artifact.category_tag: Inverse eigenvalue problems for Hermitian matrices
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a definitive characterization or a published proof resolving this specific inverse eigenvalue problem relating the eigenvalues of two Hermitian matrices $A$, $B$ to the singular values of $A+iB$. While the analogous Horn-type problems for sums of Hermitian matrices are solved, no source clearly establishes that this combined problem has been settled, so its current status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Inverse Eigenvalue Problems (Chu, SIAM Review)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of inverse eigenvalue problems; existence questions for several variants remain open.
status_evidence.claim: General survey indicating that several inverse eigenvalue existence problems are still open.

status_evidence.title: Eigenvalues and sums of Hermitian matrices (Tao)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of Horn's conjecture and related characterizations for eigenvalues of sums of Hermitian matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Solutions exist for related Horn-type problems, but the joint $A,B,A+iB$ singular-value problem is not addressed.
